accounting_scope: Inverse normalization adds one base-field multiplication per element. Device values and twiddle arrays are unchanged; the inverse table replaces rather than coexists with the forward one. The CUDA normalization introduces no extra global pass; the host oracle uses explicit scaling loops and is not a GPU traffic measurement. Host setup/root/scale computations, launches and runtime remain costs. No full remainder pipeline, PCS scatter, hash/salts, complete physical peak, service rate or real Gamma is credited.

scope: Square and odd-log inverse transforms reuse the forward kernels with inverse-root twiddles and normalization fused into the final transpose or merge. Sixteen tiny host DFT/roundtrip cases, a normalized off-diagonal/diagonal tile model, simulated GPU metadata failures and inverse CLI/output routing are checked. Static sm_90 build and full SASS are retained; no device execution.
